description: Adaptive compensation parameters for SO-101 Robot 0 (auto-calibrated)
_pick_z_offset_comment: Per-robot pick descent boost (meters, signed). Added to execute_pick_object's commanded pick_z. Negative = descend further to absorb residual sag the gravity_sag model leaves uncompensated. Set to -0.030 (descend 3cm extra) on 2026-05-06 — production logs showed fingertip stopping ~5mm below block top instead of intended 15mm dive (red block: pick_z cmd=34mm, actual=44mm; effective dive only 5mm). MIN_PICK_Z=0 clamp protects against below-table commands for short objects.

gravity_sag._comment: Hand-tuned over auto-cal (auto fit settled at base_sag=0 because no-payload calibration data was ~6mm at low z; production pick with payload showed 14.7mm at reach=0.27). base_sag=0.20 + reach_power=2.0 reproduces the 14.7mm pick-region observation while preserving cantilever-style reach^2 scaling. gain=0.24 retained for high-z extra droop.
